testcase.system-out: Scenario: Enable creation by selecting a template ✔> Given a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/document-creation-native-candidate.opj` as its active project ✔> And the native catalog contains metric and inch templates in their respective folders ✔> And the catalog root has no direct template files ✔ Given the user opens the new-document template chooser for the first time in this fresh session ✔ And the user chooses Home before selecting any template ✔ And no template is selected ✔ And the selected template root has no direct template entries ✔ And the template details are blank ✔ And Create is disabled ✔ When the user selects the metric template folder ✔ Then template tiles are displayed ✔ And Create remains disabled ✔ When the user selects the standard metric assembly template ✔ Then its assembly details are displayed ✔ And Create is enabled
